---
title: "Usage: building the basic datasets"
---


## Configuration

Run these scripts from the repository root. Dependencies are managed with `uv`: configure by running `uv sync`.

The examples below use a variable `UA` for `--user-agent`.  Use your own contact info for this value. Example: `UA='biblissima-py (you@example.org)'`


## Collect data about manuscripts


This creates `data/mss.cex`.

`uv run biblissima mss --cache-dir .cache/biblissima --user-agent "$UA"`

This generates thousands of throttled requests, and is time consuming. To test it out with a small number of requests, add `--limit N`. 

## Collect data about texts


This creates `data/texts.cex`. 


(needs the CTS catalogue and the Wikidata author numbers)


```bash
for r in PerseusDL/canonical-greekLit PerseusDL/canonical-latinLit OpenGreekAndLatin/First1KGreek; do
  d=data/cts-sources/$(basename $r)
  git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/$r.git $d
  git -C $d sparse-checkout set --no-cone '**/__cts__.xml'
done
curl -sG https://query.wikidata.org/sparql \
  --data-urlencode 'query=SELECT ?p ?tlg ?phi WHERE { { ?p wdt:P3576 ?tlg } UNION { ?p wdt:P6941 ?phi } }' \
  -H 'Accept: application/sparql-results+json' -A "$UA" > data/wikidata_tlg_phi.json
uv run biblissima texts --cache-dir .cache/biblissima --user-agent "$UA" \
  --cts data/cts-sources/canonical-greekLit data/cts-sources/canonical-latinLit data/cts-sources/First1KGreek \
  --wikidata data/wikidata_tlg_phi.json
```

## Index texts to manuscripts

This creates `data/textindex.cex`. Both `data/mss.cex` and `data/texts.cex` must already exist.

`uv run biblissima textindex --cache-dir .cache/biblissima --user-agent "$UA"`


## Collect alternate names


This creates  `data/groupnames.cex, data/worknames.cex`

`uv run biblissima names --cache-dir .cache/biblissima --user-agent "$UA"`


## Package a data release

This uses `data/mss.cex`, `data/texts.cex`, `data/textindex.cex`, `data/groupnames.cex` and `data/worknames.cex` to create `datareleases/<version>.cex` where `<version>` is the value in `dataversion.txt`

`uv run biblissima release`
